messages:
Maria P: Heads up — I have a visitor arriving at 2pm (external partner) who's bringing a fragile prototype. It’s marked 'FRAGILE' and needs to be signed for. Can the front desk hold it and not put it on the mail shelf?
Front Desk: @Maria P noted. We'll label it 'HOLD FOR MARIA P' and keep it behind the counter. Can you share the tracking number or expected courier? :white_check_mark:
Maria P: Thanks! Carrier is 'FastLines' — tracking FL-998-77. Package is small-ish, foam-lined box, ~8x6x4. Visitor name is Sam Hirano.
Front Desk: Copy that. We'll ask for ID matching the delivery name before releasing. We'll log in the deliveries binder.
James L: Quick Q — Sam wants to hotdesk near conference room B after the dropoff. Is there a res desk I can reserve, or should I hand him my hotdesk? :thinking_face:
Alex R: If you don't need it, James, I can move to the mezzanine and free the one by conf B. Otherwise Niki can confirm available spots.
James L: I'm flexible, Alex — if you don't mind. Saves me a desk shuffle later. :thumbsup:
Niki (People Ops): We have one free hotdesk right next to conf B from 1:30–4:30. I'll reserve it under 'Sam Hirano - visitor' and put a Post-it on the desk. Also I'll email security to whitelist the visitor for elevator access.
Maria P: Amazing — thank you everyone. Quick note for Front Desk: please do not scan the visitor badge into the shared badge loaner bin; hand it directly to Sam and collect on departure.
Front Desk: Will do. We'll show the visitor the badge scanner and hand it over personally. We'll also take a photo of the delivery label for records.
Delivery Bot: Delivery update: FL-998-77 arrived at 13:58. Delivered to front desk. Handler: K. Ortega.
Niki (People Ops): I'll drop by around 1:55 to greet Sam and walk him to the desk. Maria — do you want us to sign on your behalf or will you meet?
Maria P: I can be there by 2:05 — if it needs a signature before, feel free to sign as 'Maria P (on-site)'.
Alex R: Can someone add a sticky note: 'Fragile — keep upright' on the package? I can do that when I pass the desk.
Front Desk: Sticky note applied. Package stored in the locked cabinet behind the counter, labeled. We'll pass it to Sam directly and log pick-up time.
James L: Thanks team. Also, heads-up to others — if you're expecting a fragile delivery, please put 'HOLD AT FRONT DESK' in the delivery instructions and cc people-ops. Makes everything smoother.
Maria P: Good tip — done. See you soon. :wave:
